content.headline: Have a project in mind?
content.subheadline: I take on four or five projects a year. Tell me about yours.

content.headline: Hello, I am Iris.
content.body: I studied typography in Reading and worked at two studios before starting on my own. I like projects with a lot of information and not much space.

project.name: Harbour Museum identity
project.excerpt: A new identity and wayfinding system for a small maritime museum.
project.content:
A new identity and wayfinding system for a small maritime museum.

The brief

The client needed something that would last ten years and work in one colour.

What we made

A system, not a logo: rules for type, colour and layout that the team can use without me.

Result

Launched on time, and still in use.

posts.name: How I price a design project
posts.excerpt: Fixed prices, three rounds and a kill fee. Why it works for both sides.
posts.content:
I price by project, never by hour.

Why

Clients know the cost before we start, and I am paid for the result, not the time.
